The restoring-FP32 candidate passed the unchanged original finite arithmetic gate. Evidence is committed and pushed as [`539edbd263583eb3dfadbe2ea6c650b87eb573f8`](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/commit/539edbd263583eb3dfadbe2ea6c650b87eb573f8), tag `evidence/issue-44-fp32-estimate-restoring-original-arithmetic`. The bundle contains 159 verified Git files; manifest SHA256 `0279cee2867986ae9c39a6705a339f42d946f93a1a4de468727cd29df7665b6d`.

The fresh original C++ test checked all **174,268 records across 14 operations with zero mismatches**. The unchanged numeric Vulkan probe dispatched all records and read back all **697,072 words / 2,788,288 bytes**, exactly equal to the original independent expectations (SHA256 `8ff8c685140f5443bf989b281cdbf744b698ef30b1bc3b063464f0a6e3165414`). The complete matching original stock result was reused with its 737 input joins and 17 completed owners; no stock recompilation or dispatch was repeated.

The actual candidate primitive module is 30,292 bytes, SHA256 `86a71e96d9467288267b1b14533c8cc81d4356e9ff65dfd746bae2536644e8cc`. Its operation-3 path calls the guarded proposal, five exact restoring steps, final remainder/sticky/common Round and original fallback. All 25 non-Divide helper instances, public interface and LocalSize64 are retained. It has Shader capability and 32-bit integer/float types, one scoped proposal NoContraction decoration, no Endpoint RTE additions, and complete 2,094-instruction assembler/readback correspondence. The fresh GPU link uses the original numeric object with canonical device/base objects; actual owned loader/LVP/LLVM maps match the pinned provider. No fresh numeric-process feature-argument trace is claimed.

All 12 owned steps and ten build seals passed within the original limits. Independent review and root checks joined 1,549 consumed files, full outputs and JUnit; all 20 observed process births were freshly absent. After verifying all 159 archive files against Git and the remote tag, the 148 completed scratch files were removed. Canonical source remains clean, committed and pushed at `4498cc41168ad29fc4c111819a4cb7ccaa54a8bf`, with one worktree on `development/minimum-step-floor-2026-10-15`.

This accepts only the original finite primitive corpus. Proposal acceptance/hit rate, retained-program equivalence and speed remain unproved; the prior ordinary native-cost decision remains `COST_PREMISE_SURVIVES_UNPROVEN`. The candidate is private and unadopted. Next are the full retained profile (17 selected modules, 18 excluded unchanged), the original eight integrated controls and unchanged four-slot/three-repeat ABBA 20+2 benefit gates. Cold-frame, full science/platform and release qualification remain open.
scope: Coherent original finite arithmetic PASS and limits recorded. Operational issue receipt stays outside next frozen source/actions/runtime closure.
